variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
